I regularly shop at Dogman Frogner when I need to buy cat food, cat litter and equipment for my cats, and I am always very satisfied. The employees are incredibly helpful, nice and good at giving good advice when I have questions about both products and my cats.

The store also has a very good selection for cats, which I really appreciate. It is clear that the people who work there care about animals and their customers. Highly recommended to all cat owners in Frogner and in Oslo!
